title: Burnaby Home Energy Rebates 2026: What Homeowners and Strata Owners Can Claim
desc: Burnaby rebates from BC Hydro, FortisBC and CleanBC for 2026, with a look at why most Burnaby households are not covered by the home rebates.
badge: Heat pumps up to $4,000 for electric-heated houses
lead: Burnaby is the apartment city of this group: only 19% of its 101,135 households live in a detached house. That means the biggest question here is whether your building is covered at all.
cards_heading: What you can claim in Burnaby in 2026
cards_intro: Amounts come from the program pages we re-read on October 2, 2026. Each card is a maximum, and most depend on how your home is heated.

cards.title: Whole-home heat pump
cards.note: Must replace electric heat such as baseboards or an electric furnace, meet 100% of the heating load at -5C and be installed by a Home Performance Contractor Network member.

cards.title: Partial heat pump
cards.note: For a heat pump that covers at least half of the heating load while replacing electric heat.

cards.title: Limited-time bonus
cards.note: Extra money on heat pump installs completed between August 1 and October 31, 2026.

cards.title: Income-qualified switch from gas, oil or propane
cards.note: CleanBC pays by income level (Level 3 / Level 2 / Level 1) for a central or three-head heat pump, for invoices from July 6, 2026.

cards.title: Insulation
cards.note: Attic, wall and basement or crawlspace work, paid per R-value added per square foot. Homes heated mainly by electricity only.

cards.title: Windows and doors
cards.note: $100 per opening, with a U-factor of 1.22 or lower.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: Only when it replaces an electric water heater.

cards.title: Solar panels
cards.note: $1,000 per kW, capped at half the cost, from an HPCN member installer.

cards.title: Battery storage
cards.note: Up to $1,500 on its own with solar, or up to $5,000 with Peak Saver enrolment.

cards.title: EV charger
cards.note: 50% of a new wall-mounted Level 2 charger, plus $200 for a power-management device.

sections: Houses, townhouses and strata are treated differently

BC Hydro's Home Renovation Rebates cover houses, and BC Hydro lists condos and apartments as excluded from them. Strata owners instead use BC Hydro's separate Condo and Apartment Rebate Program, and our strata guide covers the amounts we verified. If you own a detached house or a townhouse with its own meter and heating, the house rebates below apply as long as it is heated mainly by electricity.

The 2021 Census counted 101,135 households. 60% own and 40% rent, and 35% live in homes built before 1981. Only about 19% live in detached houses, and 9,220 of the pre-1981 homes are owner-occupied detached houses. Those 9,220 houses are the realistic target for the insulation and window rebates. Another 6.0% of households reported needing major repairs, which is above the share in Surrey (3.8%) or Coquitlam (4.4%).
If you rent or live in a building you do not control

Tenants cannot apply for a heat pump or insulation rebate on a building they do not own, but a BC Hydro account holder in a rental house can apply or sign a consent form for the account holder. Renters on lower incomes may qualify for free upgrades through the Energy Conservation Assistance Program, and BC Hydro's Peak Saver offers free thermostats for baseboard-heated homes from October 2026. Ask your landlord whether they intend to claim an upgrade before you spend your own money.

The January average low is 1.1°C and the coldest recorded day in 2015 to 2024 was -16.2°C. Heat pumps run comfortably through most Burnaby winters. The same units cool in July, so many owners price a heat pump as air conditioning with a heating benefit.

claim_steps: Confirm whether you own a house, a townhouse or a strata unit.
For a house, check that it is heated mainly by electricity before getting heat pump or insulation quotes.
For a strata unit, read the strata guide and ask the council about outdoor unit rules.
If income is lower, ask about CleanBC and free upgrades before paying for anything.
Keep invoices, since BC Hydro gives six months to apply after the invoice date.
faq: Why does Burnaby have so many exclusions?
Because 81% of households do not live in a detached house. BC Hydro's Home Renovation Rebates exclude condos and apartments, and those buildings have their own program.
Can a Burnaby tenant claim a rebate?
The account holder applies or signs a consent form. A tenant who pays the bill but does not own the building usually cannot install permanent upgrades without the landlord.
What is the biggest house rebate here?
Insulation up to $5,500, heat pump up to $4,000 and windows up to $2,000, all for electric-heated houses.
How much colder is Burnaby than Victoria?
The January average low is 1.1 degrees Celsius against Victoria's 3.0, and the record low is -16.2 against -10.6.
